reason: Selected fixed-budget ablations support multi-view extraction and qualified consolidation checks.

candidates.title: Separate memory views before indexing mixed dialogue facts
candidates.rule: For conversational memory containing events, preferences and constraints, compare complementary write-time views with a single structured extraction under the same retrieval budget.
candidates.passage: Removing multi-view organization gives the weakest Judge and BLEU-1
candidates.finding: On the Qwen3-8B ablation at K=30, full multi-view memory scores 0.837 judge accuracy versus 0.774 for single-view structured extraction. Random rather than diversity-based view selection scores 0.777.
candidates.conditions: Views are selected from history and guide provenance-grounded extraction before standard retrieval.
candidates.limitations: One fixed-budget component ablation and model-based judging; extraction and consolidation depend on LLM behavior. Other languages, multi-party dialogue and rapid distribution changes remain untested.
candidates.validation_test: Compare single-view, random-view and complementary-view extraction at equal retrieved tokens; measure missing evidence, unsupported memories, QA and write-time cost.

candidates.title: Check temporal distinctions when consolidating redundant memories
candidates.rule: When cleaning a conversational-memory index, test consolidation for retrieval coverage while checking that changing facts and distinct events remain distinguishable.
candidates.passage: offline consolidation can over-merge when subtle temporal changes should keep items separate
candidates.finding: Removing consolidation raises the no-relevant-evidence rate from 5.14% to 9.83% at K=30. The recommendation to test temporal preservation is inferred from the authors’ stated over-merging limitation, not a measured safeguard.
candidates.conditions: Consolidation happens offline and retains provenance; history may contain updates rather than duplicates.
candidates.limitations: The ablation supports the combined cleanup component, not an isolated temporal-preservation strategy. Provenance retention alone does not prevent over-merging.
candidates.validation_test: Inject repeated facts, corrections and similarly worded distinct events; compare cleaned and original indexes for coverage, stale answers and loss of temporal distinctions.

review_scope: Selected abstract, introduction, methods or main-result sections; not a comprehensive paper or appendix review.
